QUOTE: Each pattern has the form `tool` or `tool:argpattern`, and both halves use `fnmatch` with no flags ... `filesystem.*` | Any tool on the filesystem server (no `:`, so tool name only)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that patterns use fnmatch, split into a tool part and an argument part at the colon, and that a pattern with no colon matches on tool name alone.
